description: Make a game key (p5g_...) so a native build (Godot, Unity, desktop, mobile) can use press5 Play. Browser games on the launch pad need no key. Give "site" (one of the account's launch pad sites) to let native players share rooms with that web build. The key is shown once; registering the same name again replaces the key.

name.description: Game name: 3-42 lowercase letters, digits, hyphens

site.description: Optional launch pad site of the same game

token.description: A press5 token (p5_...). Only needed when the MCP connection has no Authorization header, e.g. right after login_check.

name: register_game
title: Get a game key for native builds
